SN_MSKILL_FW_HANGA_ATTACK01_TT_DESC.name: Skill causing damages to the surrounding foes by leaping high and landing hard by making use of the skills acquired by Hang-A when running away after stealing the life elixir.

SN_MSKILL_FW_HANGA_ATTACK02_TT_DESC.name: Skill exercised by Hang-A who escaped to the Moon to beat the rabbits. The skill emits ominous forces to make the foe sick.

SN_MSKILL_FW_HANGA_ATTACK03_TT_DESC.name: Skill exercised by Hang-A staying in the Moon alone while driving darkness away. The skill heals abnormal conditions of the adjacent colleagues.

SN_MSKILL_FW_TAESE_ATTACK01_TT_DESC.name: Tai-Sui emits winds of the desert to driving the approaching foe out, and expels the foes or blurs vision of the foe.

SN_MSKILL_FW_TAESE_ATTACK03_TT_DESC.name: Skill to cause damages to annoying objects by stomping the feet. Those with weak legs fall down due to vibration on the earth.

SN_MSKILL_FW_TAESE_ATTACK07_TT_DESC.name: Skill for attacking surrounding foe by spinning the own body as a top. Foe colliding with the body may bleed.

SN_MSKILL_FW_BIGSPIDER_ATTACK01_TT_DESC.name: Skill causing great damages to the front foe by striking the earth strongly with the forelegs with a force so great to collapse a huge mountain.

SN_MSKILL_FW_BIGSPIDER_ATTACK02_TT_DESC.name: Firing the deadly poison hidden inside the body is fired to damage the foe. The deadly poison of Taisan Monster intoxicates the foe as well as makes the body of the foe dull.

SN_MSKILL_FW_BIGSPIDER_ATTACK03_TT_DESC.name: Skill attacking the front foe by firing spider web containing deadly poison. This skill intoxicates the foe as well as binds the body of the foe with the sticky nature of the web.

SN_MSKILL_FW_DARKEAGLE_ATTACK01_TT_DESC.name: As snatching feed on the earth, the monster descends and snatch foe with its feet to damage the foe.

SN_MSKILL_FW_DARKEAGLE_ATTACK02_TT_DESC.name: The monster brings black wind by spreading its wings in the air. Foe not able of withstanding the wind is expelled.

SN_MSKILL_FW_DARKEAGLE_ATTACK03_TT_DESC.name: The monster howls while rising in the air by beating its wings to cause fear to the surrounding foe so great that the foe does not dare to look at the monster. This skill is called Black Fear.

SN_MSKILL_FW_HAGIAZO_ATTACK01_TT_DESC.name: The enraged bear strikes the front foe four times in row to express its rage. Foe not capable of withstanding rage of the bear falls down and is tramped under the great foreleg of the bear.

SN_MSKILL_FW_HAGIAZO_ATTACK03_TT_DESC.name: Skill of the bear beating its body with its forelegs to express its pleasure when looking the falling foe. Expression of excessive pleasure causes damage to and brings down the surrounding foe.

SN_MSKILL_FW_HAGIAZO_ATTACK05_TT_DESC.name: Skill of howling to sooth depressing heart when witnessing the foe not easily falling down. The tremendous howling causes damage to the surrounding foe, and brings them into panic conditions.

SN_MSKILL_FW_WHITETIGER_ATTACK01_TT_DESC.name: The monster claws the foe with sharp forelegs twice to cause great damage to the foe.

SN_MSKILL_FW_WHITETIGER_ATTACK02_TT_DESC.name: The monster uses its iron fangs to bite the neck of the foe to put an end to the foe’s life.

SN_MSKILL_FW_WHITETIGER_ATTACK03_TT_DESC.name: Magic of scope mode used whenever driving ghosts away, which is visible to the eyes of the tiger only.

SN_MSKILL_FW_HYEONGCHEON_ATTACK03_TT_DES.name: Skill to make the surrounding foe experience the ice hell by striking the earth with a hammer. The foe subject to the piercing cold gets frostbitten, or frozen.

SN_MSKILL_FW_HYEONGCHEON_ATTACK04_TT_DES.name: Skill to make the surrounding foe experience the electricity hell by striking the earth with a hammer. The foe not capable of withstanding electricity so strong to paralyze its body is shocked.

SN_MSKILL_FW_HYEONGCHEON_ATTACK06_TT_DES.name: Skill to make the surrounding foe experience the eternity hell by striking the earth with a hammer. The foe not capable of withstanding the impact loses strength of the legs and falls down.

SN_MSKILL_FW_MUJIGI_ATTACK04_TT_DESC.name: Skill of repeated two strikes against the front foe by summoning lightning. Some foes are shocked by the strong power of lightning.

SN_MSKILL_FW_MUJIGI_ATTACK05_TT_DESC.name: Skill of repeated two strikes against the front foe by summoning cloud. Some foes are caught by magic force of darkness by the force of dismal cloud.

SN_MSKILL_FW_MUJIGI_ATTACK06_TT_DESC.name: Skill for soothing anger by striking the earth with the fists while promising revenge whenever the monster recalls insult from Ishutar. The tremendous force of anger causes the foe fall down.

SN_MSKILL_FW_KYKLOPES_ATTACK04_TT_DESC.name: The monster strikes foe three times in a row as if it gives the foe caution.

SN_MSKILL_FW_KYKLOPES_ATTACK05_TT_DESC.name: Skill powerfully striking down the stone column to execute of judgment of justice to the surrounding foes that mislead their way. Some foe subject to execution of the judgment faint.

SN_MSKILL_FW_KYKLOPES_ATTACK06_TT_DESC.name: The monster gets rageful when it witnesses foes committing meaningless murder, and leaps up from its standing to cause damage to the surrounding foes.

SN_MSKILL_FW_BATTLEGOLEM_ATTACK02_TT_DES.name: Skill of firing fists made of stone to damage all of the foes between the target and Golem.

SN_MSKILL_FW_BATTLEGOLEM_ATTACK03_TT_DES.name: Skill giving impact on the earth by powerfully striking down the earth with the both arms. Foes in the vicinity of Golem not capable of withstanding the impact fall down.

SN_MSKILL_FW_BATTLEGOLEM_ATTACK04_TT_DES.name: Skill leaping high to remove dusts and spoils from the body. Dusting damages the surrounding foes. Powerful dusting sometimes makes the foes spiritless.

SN_ITEM_COS_P_JINN_SCROLL_TT_DESC.name: <sml2>Genies - spirits with mysterious powers that appear in the Arabian region. SN_THEME_GOD_FLAME_BURNING_ABYSS_TT_DESC.name: The fire that rages ceaselessly on the Flame Mountain... This collection of sweltering heat is filled with souls that are as scorching and wild as that fire. [Upon completion, you may receive your reward from the Hunter Associate Ahmok.]

SN_THEME_GOD_WRECK_GREEN_DEEP_SEE_TT_DES.name: A collection of memories buried in the deep abyss of the ocean. One can sense the warmth and the affectionate longing of a lover forgotten for a long time. [Upon completion, you may receive your reward from the Guild Manager Musai.]

SN_THEME_GOD_WRECK_BLAME_SEE_TT_DESC.name: The endless sea even devours tears. This collection is of a spirit whose sorrow and longing were so powerful that they became bitter resentment. [Upon completion, you may receive your reward from Governor Senmut.]

SN_ITEM_TALISMAN_TT_DESC.name: This talisman is an ancient artifact bound by mysterious powers.  It can be registered in the collection book, after which the hidden story behind the artifact may be read.  A powerful reward awaits those who complete a single collection theme after collecting these by type.

SN_ITEM_TALISMAN_TOGUI_RED_TEARS_TT_DESC.name: Crystallization of a Togui's tears.  The ominous redness reminds one of blood, and yet, it has the kind of beauty that cannot be described with words.  Historical records show how treasured it was in that that these red tears, which can only be created by Toguis, were offered to the Emperor as a gift after the generals eradicated the Toguis.  Its beauty created much jealousy among gem cutters who then attempted to cut something that would come close to it.  Yet, of all the red gems, there was none that could match up to the beauty of the red tears. In Donhwang of China, a story is told of a young man who was killed by the townsfolk after becoming a Togui by eating strange ingredients in order to create a gem to give to his lover.

SN_ITEM_TALISMAN_TOGUI_WESTERN_SCRIPTURE.name: A Buddhist scripture book brought from the western region by a certain monk.  A book which records in detail the teachings of the Buddha in an age where intact scriptures didn't exist, every Buddhist wished to read it at least once.  Every character known to have been written with sincerity and to have mysterious powers, this scripture book was often a target for many demons and villains due to its value.  However, every time, this book would mysteriously return to its original place intact, thus winning a deeper awe of the people. The story of a high-ranking monk who, unable to resist the temptation to own it, stole the scripture book and murdered the guardian monk three times, thus becoming a demon as a punishment, is a particularly well-known tale.

SN_ITEM_TALISMAN_TOGUI_TOGUI_MASK_TT_DES.name: A mask made of ground human skulls.  They are said to have been in use due to the belief that wearing the mask made of ground human skulls would grant the wearer the wisdom.  Therefore, the more the masks, the more the Togui would be praised as a wise one, soon to become the next chief to leave the Toguis.  This is perhaps the reason why many headless corpses in a region where Toguis are very active in their pillaging.  It is also said that there are always conflicts big and small among the Toguis themselves to seize one another's masks.

SN_ITEM_TALISMAN_TOGUI_RED_TALISMAN_TT_D.name: Toguis believe that human blood, bones and skin have miraculous powers.  In particular, they believe that human blood has the power to drive out ill fortune.  Red Talismans are made with human blood, mainly to wish safety upon the Toguis as they jump into battle.  Often, the most skilled sorcerer within the tribe creates the talismans.  It is said that the sorcerer enchants humans to offer their own blood voluntarily. A horrible story is told of a young man from a certain village near Donhwang who, enchanted by a Togui Sorcerer, killed everyone in the village, young and old, and eventually cut himself as well.  With this blood, he turned this talisman red, so the story goes.

SN_ITEM_TALISMAN_TOGUI_PUPPETS_TT_DESC_S.name: While the Togui Sorcerers possessed high intelligence among the Togui tribes, their physical capacity lacked greatly.  This created a need for a subordinate that would do all the troublesome or dangerous work for them.  This is how these puppets came to be. Born between the bark of an old tree and the breath of a rotting root, the puppets are capable of some offensive and defensive skills, though not outstanding.  These puppets are used for a variety of purposes.  They play the role of body guards to Togui Sorcerers, although they also assist other Toguis in their battle if need be.  Some puppets descend down upon the world of humans on behalf of Togui Sorcerers to collect and offer them human souls.

SN_ITEM_TALISMAN_TOGUI_KITCHEN_KNIFE_TT_.name: Toguis generally reach adulthood in five years after their birth.  When they become adults, they are given a crude sword as a mark of being an adult.  This sword becomes their first as well as their last.  This is because they believe that, as they receive the sword, they enter into a pact with the god of metal within the sword. They also believe that those who abuse the sword are severely punished, and so they don't sharpen the sword once after they receive it.  The consistent dullness of Toguis' swords testify to this.  A Togui who either loses or breaks the sword is forever banished from the tribe by the fellow tribesmen who fear the wrath of the god of metal.  For this reason, this sword is more important than life to a Togui.

SN_ITEM_TALISMAN_TOGUI_SPELL_PAPERS_TT_D.name: Toguis generally have low intelligence.  Although the Togui Sorcerers have the highest intelligence among them, this is only relative.  Because of this, Toguis felt the need to record their wisdom so as not to forget it, and they wrote with animal blood on old piles of paper.  This is called the Spell Paper.  It contains a variety of their cultural insights, anything from curses small and large, how to create and breathe life into a puppet, to the procedures of a ritual to drive out ill fortune.  This is of great value to any scholar who studies the level of the Togui intelligence.

SN_ITEM_TALISMAN_TOGUI_ELDER_STAFF_TT_DE.name: The Elder Staff, pass down from one chief to the next, symbolizes the absolute authority of the chief.  Although its shape may vary from one tribe to the next, it is generally made of a thick wooden stick with a monkey skull mounted on top, small stakes inserted on the sides and pebbles with holes hanging off of them.  The shiny pebbles each represent the sun, the moon, fire, water and earth.  The wooden stick represents the forest and the skull the afterlife.  Toguis believed that their chief oversaw all of this, and those who would act against this authority would receive the divine punishment.  Thus, they did not think to challenge the chief's authority.

SN_ITEM_TALISMAN_FLAME_FIRE_FLOWER_TT_DE.name: One of the mutant breed of flowers on the Flame Mountain, these flowers bloom not in petals but in buds of beautiful flame.  They absorb nutrients through fire energy instead of water, and they also act as the energy house of fire.  This makes them popular among monsters who favor fire, and many transactions, small and large, take place at a black market on the Flame Mountain on any given day. The story of Flame Witches and Flame Ghosts fighting for seven days and seven nights for these flowers is something of an old legend on the Flame Mountain.

SN_ITEM_TALISMAN_FLAME_HORNED_CATTLE_TT_.name: The name of this horn refers to the horn of the ruler of the Flame Mountain, the Flame Cow King.  The name is also interpreted as the symbol of his authority as well as the source of his endless strength.  The Flame Cow King lived up to his title of the god of battles and saw battles too numerous to count.  It is said that this is perhaps why his horns are dark red in color as though they were stained with blood. It is said that, when his son, Honghaea, died by the hands of Sonogong, the bitter sorrow caused the Flame Cow King to cut off his own horns to mourn the death of his son.  This shows a glimpse into how bitter his grief must have been after losing his son.

SN_ITEM_TALISMAN_FLAME_FLAME_OF_OBLIVION.name: This utterly red magic stone is known to be created only after molding the lava flowing on the Flame Mountain for three days.  Because the stone contains the heat of lava, an average monster would turn into ashes upon touching it.  Even if the monster could resist it, it is said, the scorching heat of the lava would burn up all the memories in the head.  Only the wife of the Flame Cow King, Nachalnyeo, can handle this magic stone thanks to her special fan.  Favoring this flame of oblivion in particular, she is said to have used this magic stone in most of her spells.

SN_ITEM_TALISMAN_FLAME_FLAME_PAPERS_TT_D.name: Originally a thing of the divine realm preserved by the divine spirits of the Heavenly Mountains, this book contains the secrets to control all the fire in the world at will.  The Flame Cow King deceived the divine spirits and supposedly stole this book and brought it into this world.  After bringing the book out into this world, it is said, the Flame Cow King created his base, the Flame Mountain, with his new powers.  The power of the Book of Flames is behind the ever-raging fire of the Flame Mountain.

SN_ITEM_TALISMAN_FLAME_HEARTHSTONE_FLAME.name: The Flame Ghost was a thousand-year-old monster who ruled the region before the Flame Cow King created the Flame Mountain with the Book of Flames.  Although his rule had continued for a long time, the appearance of the Flame Cow King shook the very roots of his rule.  The Flame Ghost was eventually defeated by the Flame Cow King.  Having lost his power and authority, the Flame Ghost turned into stone, torn to hundreds of pieces and scattered throughout the Flame Mountain.  This stone contains the venomous resentment of the Flame Ghost; a weak person would lose his mind simply by grabbing the stone.  A rumor has it that one can achieve outstanding effects when this stone is used as an ingredient for the cursed wine.

SN_ITEM_TALISMAN_FLAME_ENCHANTRESS_NECKL.name: A necklace cherished by the Flame Cow King's wife, Nachalnyeo, this originally belonged to a Flame Witch.  The Flame Witch was reputed to be the most beautiful one on the Flame Mountain.  Jealous of her beauty, Nachalnyeo lured her out with lies and stole her necklace.  The necklace is said to contain the witch's power to enchant others.  Nachalnyeo has supposedly benefited greatly from this power when she seduced the Flame Cow King.

SN_ITEM_TALISMAN_FLAME_HONGHAEAH_ARMOR_T.name: Armor crafted by the Flame Cow King himself for the age of coming ceremony for his son, Honghaea.  It is a well-known tale that the Flame Cow King cut off one of his horns to create this armor.  This also proves the depth of his love for his son.  When Honghaea was defeated by Sonogong, and this armor was returned with his body, the Flame Cow King is said to have cried standing for a full week before the armor, not moving an inch.

SN_ITEM_TALISMAN_FLAME_FIRE_DRAGON_SWORD.name: The Flame Cow King is monster with immense strength which befits one who is called the god of battle.  His strength was so immense that he could overwhelm most enemies easily without the use of a weapon.  Only when he encounters a worthy opponent, does he reveal the Fire Dragon Sword.  Weighing nearly 2400 pounds, there was no one who would wield this weapon.  This is also the only weapon that could match Sonogong's staff.

SN_ITEM_TALISMAN_WRECK_A_SILVER_PENDANT_.name: This was given to Alberto as a gift by his lover, Ceila, on the day he set sail.  Judging by the traditional belief that silver has the power to drive away demons, it is speculated that this was given to Alberto as a charm to keep him safe.  It can be opened, and a small portrait of Ceila is placed inside.  Alberto did not let go of this charm to his final moments.

SN_ITEM_TALISMAN_WRECK_A_COBALT_EMERALD_.name: Not long after setting sail, Alberto's ship encountered a pirate ship.  Once he barely escaped their pursuit hiding in a rocky region, he later struck them back successfully by laying ambush.  With it, all the booty of the pirates came into the possession of Alberto and his men.  The loot most cherished by Alberto was this cobalt emerald.  Alberto is said to have missed Ceila greatly, looking at the emerald which represents youthful innocence.  With this, he planned to ask her hand in marriage upon his return - except that he did not return.

SN_ITEM_TALISMAN_WRECK_A_LOGBOOK_TT_DESC.name: Captain's log recorded by Alberto.  This log records all of his adventures out on the open sea.  It mentions Ceila throughout, showing how much Alberto missed her.  Judging by what is recorded in the log, it seems that Alberto's journey has been mostly uneventful other than his encounter with the pirates.  However, the encounter with the Kraken at the end seems to be the conclusive factor in the sinking of his ship.

SN_ITEM_TALISMAN_WRECK_A_LOVE_LETTER_TT_.name: A letter for Ceila written by Alberto himself.  A long letter of five pages, it is filled with his love and longing for her from top to finish.  He had originally planned to mail it to her once he arrived at the port.  However, this letter could not be sent due to the sinking of the ship when he encountered the Kraken.  Now, the letter rests with the shipwreck deep in the abyss.

SN_ITEM_TALISMAN_WRECK_A_PORTRAIT_WOMAN_.name: A portrait of Ceila, Alberto's lover.  When Alberto's ship did not return after the appointed time, people assumed that he was now dead.  However, Ceila refused to believe them and waited for her love at the port for years.  Then, all of a sudden, she vanished one day.  Some said that she succumbed to her longing for Alberto and threw herself into the ocean, while others claimed that she agreed to a pact with a sea witch, searching the seas for Alberto as a mermaid.

SN_ITEM_TALISMAN_WRECK_A_JEWELRY_BOX_TT_.name: This box is full of treasure collected by pirates by the name of the Epsilons as they ambushed merchant ships passing through their territory.  The box is filled with anything from ordinary gold coins to various rare treasures.  However, the Epsilons were defeated by Alberto and all the treasure was taken away.  Having lost his treasure and his pride damaged, the captain of the Epsilons, Giler, began pursuing Alberto with bitter resentment.  As they awoke the abysmal monster, Kraken, towards the end of the pursuit, the situation got out of hand.

SN_ITEM_TALISMAN_WRECK_A_DIAMOND_WATCHES.name: A pocket with a large diamond set in the middle.  The beautiful luster and the outer appearance testify to its high value.  As such, this item is mainly traded among the nobles.  Alberto took it from the jewelry box of the Epsilons.  However, with the sinking of the ship, this watch sank to the bottom of the sea along with its value.

SN_ITEM_TALISMAN_WRECK_A_MERMAID_TEARS_T.name: A gem made from hardened teardrops of a mermaid.  A mermaid began appearing at the shipwreck site and ceaselessly cried looking at the remains of the ship.  It is said that she looked so mysterious and yet so sad that no one could dare approach her.  Some claim that this is Ceila, who turned into a mermaid in search of Alberto.  When she couldn't find her lover, they say, she came all the way out here.

SN_ITEM_TALISMAN_WRECK_B_BROKEN_KEY_TT_D.name: This is the Giler's damaged pirate ship now sunken into the ocean.  The hull is heavily damaged, as if to testify to the desperation of the final moments before sinking.  The water spirit, Sereness, never approached this sunken pirate ship, because of her memories with her beloved Giler.  So great was Sereness' sorrow that no one could approach the ship except monsters and ghosts.

SN_ITEM_TALISMAN_WRECK_B_LARGE_TONGS_TT_.name: These are the broken claws of King Nippers.  When Sereness appeared before Giler in the human form was when Giler's pirate ship was in danger surrounded by a group of King Nippers.  After defeating the King Nippers and rescuing Giler, she fell in love with him, a human - an unthinkable deed for a spirit.  Even though she knew that she was only being used by him, she could do nothing else but help them because of her love.

SN_ITEM_TALISMAN_WRECK_B_PHANTOM_HALF_TT.name: After the pirate ship sank and Giler died, great sorrow and pain tormented Sereness.  It is said that Sereness acquired the Harp of Dreams from a sea witch to erase her own memory.  However, after erasing Giler from her memories seven times, she remembered him against seven times.  Memories may be erased, but love is etched on one's heart, never to be erased.  Sereness' sorrow continued on ever since.

SN_ITEM_TALISMAN_WRECK_B_EVIL_HEART_TT_D.name: It was Sereness' duty as a water spirit to maintain the order of the seas.  Fallen into great sorrow after Giler's death, she drove herself as a ruthless warrior in order that she might forget everything.  Her sword, mercilessly wielded, defeated numerous monsters.  Sereness is said to have taken enough hearts of monsters to form a mountain.

SN_ITEM_TALISMAN_WRECK_B_REVENGEFUL_SPIR.name: Sereness is said to have taken out her sorrowful heart and hidden it in order to hide her grief.  This heart is the bead of vindictive spirit.  However, no matter how hard she tried to abandon her sorrow, her soul was ultimately not redeemed.  Rather, this attracted many monsters to the abyss that consume evil energy.

SN_ITEM_TALISMAN_WRECK_B_HOOK_HAND_TT_DE.name: This artificial hand in the shape of a hook is the hand of Giler, the pirate captain of the Epsilons.  Once notorious for pillaging small and large out on the open seas, Giler was defeated by Alberto.  With his pride damaged, he pursued Alberto to the end for revenge.  When his pursuit failed, he made the foolish choice of using Sereness to awake Kraken in the abyss.  He was successful in burying Alberto in the abyss - but not before he, too, was buried in the same sea.

SN_ITEM_TALISMAN_WRECK_B_COMMANDER_PATCH.name: This eye patch was used by Giler, the pirate captain of the Epsilons.  He supposedly began wearing this eye patch when he lost one of his eyes during a pursuit by the naval fleet.  He faced more perils after that, almost losing his life.  He tenaciously continued to survive and took his place as the pirate captain.

SN_ITEM_TALISMAN_WRECK_B_SERENITY_TEARS_.name: This gem is the hardened tears of Sereness.  After witnessing the death of the pirate captain, Giler, with her own eyes, she is said to have shed tears, lost in the flow of time.  This gem contains her sorrow, love, and resentment.  She never even came close to the shipwreck since then in order not to stir memories of Giler.  Many of her tears are said to be still resting near the shipwreck.
